extraction_notes: Identity evidence is preserved: the supplied manufacturer string is exactly UMW(Youtai Semiconductor Co., Ltd.); the datasheet title and branding identify UMW, while the footer identifies UTD Semiconductor Co.,Limited.

This is a P-channel MOSFET. Voltage and current values from signed P-channel axes or table entries are stored as positive magnitudes for fitting, while original signs are retained in conditions and axis names such as -VGS, -ID, -VDS, and -VSD.

The electrical-characteristics heading states TA = 25 °C. Figure 5 provides an explicit 25 °C transfer curve; Figures 1 and 8 are typical plots without a temperature label, so their conditions do not claim an unstated temperature.

VGS(th) publishes MIN = -0.4 V and MAX = -1.5 V with no TYP entry. RDS(on) publishes MIN/MAX bounds for the -4.5 V and -2.5 V rows and MAX only for the -1.8 V row; duplicated rdson_points preserve those column meanings.

Ciss is a typical 600 pF table value whose row has no explicit VDS, VGS, or frequency bias. Coss and Crss are typical values at VDS = -10 V, VGS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz. Figure 8 is digitized at its stated f = 1 MHz and VGS = 0 V.
Curve points are manual readings of actual plotted traces at grid locations, converted to SI units where necessary; they are not calculated or interpolated model points.
